Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team liked the latency/cost numbers. Procurement is picking up the GCP Marketplace path and we have a few gating questions before we can move to legal/PO:

- Billing connector: do you support invoice-pricing mapping from Marketplace SKUs to our redwood account (we need to map usage to our internal cost centers)?
- Pricing models: is there a SKU-level price list or will Redwood provide a single marketplace SKU with metered usage?
- Contracting: do we need a Redwood-signed MSA before Marketplace listing or can we use a standard GCP Marketplace purchase flow + PO?
- Compliance: can you share SOC2 report and data retention policy (we'll attach our vendor RFI).

We're aiming to get procurement gating closed by Dec 10 if possible. Attached: acme_sow.xlsx (high-level scope) and our RFI.

Can we schedule a 30 min sync to run through the billing mapping and PO path? Our procurement lead is Lisa Tran (copied on future replies).

Thanks,
Lisa Tran

Acme Retail

Hi Lisa — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the SOW.

Short answers up front:
- Billing connector: yes — we support SKU-to-invoice mapping and can provide a billing adapter that emits usage lines compatible with GCP billing exports. We'll need your cost-center mapping file to pre-configure.
- SKUs: Redwood typically publishes a single metered SKU for Marketplace and can also support multiple SKUs for addons. We will share the proposed SKU structure and a short pricing matrix.
- Contracting: procurement can either accept the GCP Marketplace purchase flow (with GCP contracts) or sign a Redwood MSA before listing; both are commonly used. If Acme needs a legal signature from us, we can loop legal and expedite.
- Compliance: attaching our onboarding checklist (redwood_gcp_marketplace_checklist.pdf) and a link to a short SOC2 package. For SOC2, we can share the report under an NDA/secure link — happy to coordinate.

Proposed next steps (30-min call):
1) Walk billing connector mapping (owner: Karthik)
2) Finalize SKU/pricing choice (owner: Soojin)
3) Confirm contracting preference (MSA vs. Marketplace flow) and timelines (owner: Kimberly)
4) Exchange SOC2 evidence and agree NDA (owner: Marcus)

Available windows: Thu 11/26 09:00–11:00 PT or Mon 11/29 14:00–16:00 PT — can you confirm?

Links and artifacts:
- Onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_redwood_gcp_onboarding
- HubSpot (deal): https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-GCP-2026-11

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference
